formula.unit: real seconds; PR44 run clock is real elapsed ms (HOUR=3600_000), so 1 game hour = 3600 s
formula.straightLineTheoreticalSeconds: straightAu / speedAuPerSec  [unobstructed neutral terrain, LOWER BOUND]
formula.geographicRouteSeconds: SUM(stepAu / terrainSpeedMultiplier(cell)) / speedAuPerSec  [raster Dijkstra on accepted GEO-01/02 masks]
formula.cartMult: road/bridge/floor=1.36, rough forest/marsh/hill/snow=0.42, otherwise=0.72 (sim.ts); a TRAIL is NEVER a cart road
formula.hungerThirst: balance.player.hungerDrainPerMin / thirstDrainPerMin * seconds/60  [modelled, no shelter/zone multiplier]

terrainClassification.reason: GEO-02 maplab_encoding.v1.json explicitly leaves the 12-code -> 14-string biome mapping open; PR44 SPEED_KEY lookup uses the strings below.
terrainClassification.roadKeys: road/bridge/floor = BAL.terrainSpeed.road/bridge (1.28) for foot; BAL.cart.speedOnRoad (1.36) for cart
terrainClassification.fordKeys: crossingCandidate=3 -> shallow (0.5) EDITOR heuristic; carts cannot ford water
